correctness.rationale: From the exact RCGLS recurrence for A=I, predecessor orthogonality makes the new search direction the orthogonal projection of an independent Gaussian sketch onto a d−1 hyperplane. Conditional spherical symmetry yields the first Beta((d−1)/2,1/2) factor and later independent Beta((d−2)/2,1/2) factors. Their means and logarithms give the exact expectation and almost-sure exponent. d=1 terminates at step one and d=2 at step two. The actual embedded checker validates 1386 rational identities and 216000 Gaussian steps. Computations do not substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: The joint error law, complete finite-dimensional boundary (finite termination exactly for d≤2), sharp expected factors, and almost-sure exponent quantify a meaningful acceleration mechanism of RCGLS not resolved by its published uniform upper bound. It is a natural exact benchmark on the identity least-squares operator, not an arbitrary isolated parameter computation. Practical speedups and general-Hessian extensions are not asserted.
